buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 4. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 5. Turnover

OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 6. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 7. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 8. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 9. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Bidder eligibility and credentials 1. OEM Authorisation Certificate The bidder shall submit a valid Authorisation Certificate issued by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (O EM) specifically authorising the bidder to participate in the subject bid and supply, install and provide warr anty support for the offered UPS system. The certificate shall clearly mention the OEM's name, bidder's na me and the product category/model being offered. 2. OEM's Establishment and Experience The offered UPS shall be manufactured by an established OEM having a minimum experience of 5 years in manufacturing Online UPS systems. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence of the OEM's incorporat ion and/or commencement of manufacturing operations. 3. Manufacturer's Quality Certification The UPS manufacturer shall possess a valid ISO 9001 certification for its quality management system. A co py of the valid certificate shall be submitted along with the technical bid. 4. Product Credentials

The bidder shall submit the official technical datasheet/catalogue of the offered UPS model, issued by the OEM, clearly indicating the technical specifications, model number, capacity, battery compatibility and oth er essential features. Self-declared specifications without supporting OEM documentation shall not be acce pted. B. Battery-specific conditions 5. Battery Manufacturer and Quality The batteries supplied shall be brand new, unused and sourced either from the UPS OEM or from another r eputed, established and recognised battery manufacturer having proven experience in manufacturing SMF -VRLA batteries. Batteries shall conform to applicable BIS/IEC standards, wherever applicable. Documentar y evidence of the battery manufacturer's credentials and technical specifications shall be submitted. 6. Battery Configuration and Backup Assurance The bidder shall provide 16 Nos. of 12V, minimum 42Ah SMF-VRLA batteries, or a technically superior confi guration, compatible with the offered UPS. The bidder shall submit an OEM-certified battery-sizing calculati on confirming a minimum backup of 30 minutes at 100% rated UPS output load. 7. Battery Manufacturing Date All batteries shall be of the same make, capacity and model, and shall be brand new and unused. The batt eries shall preferably be of the same make as recommended by the UPS OEM or of any other reputed, esta blished and prominent battery manufacturer of equivalent or superior quality, subject to compatibility with the offered UPS. Batteries manufactured not earlier than six months prior to the date of supply shall be acc epted. 8. Battery Warranty The batteries shall carry a minimum comprehensive onsite warranty of two years from the date of success ful installation and commissioning. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects, premature failure and replacement of defective batteries without any additional cost to the University. C. After-sales service and warranty 9. Service Support Infrastructure The OEM shall have an established authorised service network in India and shall provide after-sales servic e support at the University premises in Jammu & Kashmir. The bidder shall furnish details of the nearest au thorised service centre, including its complete address and contact details. 10. Service Response Time The successful bidder/OEM shall provide onsite technical support within 48 hours of receiving a service co mplaint from the University. Any defective component or battery shall be repaired or replaced within a rea sonable timeframe without additional financial liability to the University. 11. Comprehensive Warranty of UPS The UPS shall carry a minimum comprehensive onsite warranty of two years from the date of successful in stallation and commissioning, covering all major components, including power modules, control cards, dis play units, cooling fans and other internal components. 12. Genuine and New Equipment The UPS and all associated components, including batteries, shall be brand new, unused and of current pro duction. Refurbished, reconditioned, second-hand or discontinued models shall not be accepted. D. Supply, installation and commissioning 13. Complete System Supply The quoted price shall be inclusive of the UPS, complete battery bank, battery rack, interconnecting cables , DC protection devices, input/output connections, accessories, installation, testing and commissioning. No additional payment shall be admissible for any component or accessory required for the satisfactory opera tion of the system.

14. Performance Demonstration The successful bidder shall demonstrate the satisfactory operation of the UPS and the stipulated 30-minute backup during commissioning. The University reserves the right to verify the performance of the supplied s ystem before acceptance. 15. OEM Warranty Confirmation The successful bidder shall submit the original OEM warranty certificate, clearly mentioning the UPS and b attery serial numbers, warranty commencement date and warranty duration. E. Additional Terms A. No substitution of battery specifications The successful bidder shall not substitute the approved battery make, model or capacity at the time of sup ply without prior written approval of the University. Any proposed alternative shall be supported by an OE M-certified technical justification and shall meet or exceed the stipulated specifications. B. Battery sizing responsibility The bidder/OEM shall remain fully responsible for ensuring that the supplied battery bank is adequately siz ed to deliver the stipulated backup time. Any shortfall in backup due to inadequate battery sizing shall be rectified by the supplier at its own cost. C. Replacement of defective batteries In the event of premature failure of any battery during the warranty period, the supplier shall replace the d efective battery with a new battery of the same or higher capacity and equivalent or superior specification s, without any additional cost. The replacement shall be compatible with the existing battery bank. .
